prompt:
Create exactly ONE transparent cutout asset of the ORIGINAL MASS EFFECT 1 THRESHER MAW in its EMERGED ABOVE-GROUND state, closely matching the three attached actual ME1 gameplay references. This is the ME1 design, not the redesigned ME2 Grunt boss or ME3 Kalros. Copy the upright frontal pose of the distant creature in reference image 1, whose entire emerged silhouette is visible between the foreground squad members. Reference images 2 and 3 are closer views of the same ME1 model: use them only to resolve anatomy, textures and the side of the head. Do not copy their bent-over pose or their camera framing.

Identity and anatomy: a thick, segmented, fleshy vertical worm trunk, warm ochre and brown frontal belly plates, dark burgundy / purple sides and back. A broad lobed alien head with FOUR oblong cyan-blue luminous patches arranged as two on each upper head lobe, as in the reference. Two large raised lateral appendages bend up and out from either side and finish in narrow long curved blade-like tips, fully visible. The reference also shows small hooked side protrusions down the trunk, long pale tusk-like curved mouth blades, fleshy mouth folds and one long vivid cyan-blue tongue extending downward. Preserve the arrangement, quantities, asymmetry of the pose, scale, widths and lengths of all observed elements precisely. Do not add insect legs, a dragon head, eyes of another shape, extra antennae, extra teeth, generic horns or a snake tail. Keep the visible lower trunk as it appears at the ground plane in image 1: a clean base cut at the emergence line. Do not invent the unseen underground body.

Composition: one creature alone, complete emerged silhouette from tips of both raised appendages down to the ground-plane cut at the base and the tip of the blue tongue. Front view as in image 1, entire figure contained, at least 12 percent empty transparent padding on every side. Preserve the native game-model stylization and texture level, use plain balanced lighting, with controlled cyan emissives and no exaggerated atmospheric glow. Maintain warm brown/ochre frontal coloring and burgundy sides evidenced by the three captures, not a new armored carapace design. No acid spray: the small yellow/green cloud seen in the screenshots is a transient combat particle, not anatomy. No ground, crater, stone base, dirt, particles, smoke, shadows, scene or background. Surroundings must be actual fully transparent alpha, with clean crisp antialiased edges and no black/gray translucent haze. Exactly ONE creature, no squadmates, no Mako, no landscape, no UI, no text, no collage, no additional views. This is a faithful static boss-body master, not a redesign.
